The horizontal axis displays the LLM names, specifically "Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B", "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0", and "RedWhale (our)", arranged in descending order by the height of the tallest bar. The vertical axis, labeled "Value", presents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick labels at 0 and 1. Each LLM's performance is represented by a set of three stacked bars, distinguished by color: dark blue for "Correct", medium blue for "Partially Correct", and light blue for "Incorrect".
